packageRules.description: LinuxServer.io images use a non-SemVer compound tag format (e.g. 5.2.0_v2.0.12-ls455). Use loose versioning so Renovate compares them correctly.
linuxserver/qbittorrent has stale Ubuntu-era CalVer tags (e.g. '20.04.1') that sort higher than the real app version tags (5.x). Explicitly ignore the known offending tag.
servercontainers/samba uses a custom composite tag format (e.g. a3.23.4-s4.22.8-r0). Use loose versioning to avoid misidentification.
pgvector uses channel tags like 'pg16' that are not version numbers — ignore them to prevent bogus upgrade PRs.
Group all non-major Docker updates into a single PR to reduce noise.
Major Docker updates always get individual PRs for manual review.
